paite: Unau kiitna om jel hen,
english: Let brotherly love continue.

paite: Mikhualte tungah itna suah ding mangngilh kei un; huchibang hihin khenkhat in theilou in angelte ana zintun ngal ua.
english: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

paite: Hen a awmte tuh hen hisam bangin thei gige unla; gimthuakte tuh sa a awmsam nahih ziakun thei gige un.
english: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them; and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

paite: Mi tengteng lak ah kitenna pahtawi in awm henla, lupna leng hihbuah louh in awm hen; kingaite leh angkawmte tuh Pathian in a ngaihtuah dek ngala.
english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

paite: Na lungsim putdan uh tuh dangka deihtakna panglou hihen; na thil neih sun tunguah lungkim un; amah mah in, bangchikmah in kawn dawn lou kei ding a, paileng ka hon paisan kei hial ding, a chi ngal a.
english: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.” Deuteronomy 31:6

paite: Huchiin, hangtakin Toupa tuh hon panpihpa ahi, ka lau kei ding; mihing in bang a hon chih thei dia? Ichi uhi.
english: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?” Psalm 118:6-7

paite: Nou hon heu, Pathian thu honhilhte, theigige unla, a awmdan ua thil suakte ngaihtuah in a hindan uh ching un.
english: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

paite: Jesu Kris tuh zan tawh, tuni tawh, chiklai peuh inleng angeingei in a awm gige ding hi.
english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

paite: Ki sinsakna tuamtuam leh lamdang mutleng in awmkei un; lungtang hehpihna a hihkip a awm tuh a hawih ngal a, nekdingte bang a hihkip a awmlou in; huchibang lam lungkhamten huaite ah phattuamna a mu tuan kei uhi.
english: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

paite: Enzaw maitam khat inei; huaituh biakbuk nasemten anek theihlouhna mun uh ahi.
english: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

paite: Gan, asisan Siampu Lianpenin Mun Siangthou a khelhna a dia lana a lutpih zel luangte tuh, dainawl ah a hal zel uhi.
english: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp. Leviticus 16:27

paite: Huchiin, Jesu in leng amah sisan mahmah a mite a hih siangthou theihna ding in, kulh kongkhak pawlam ah ana thuakta hi.
english: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

paite: Huchiin, amah a muhsitna uh pu in dainawl ah a kianglam ah ipai khe ding uhi.
english: Let us therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

paite: Hialai a zaw khaw munkip inei ngalkei a, khaw hong awm ding izong ahizaw hi.
english: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

paite: Huchiin, amah vangin phatna kithawihna Pathian kiang ah ilan gige ding uh, huaituh amin gupna mukte gah ahi.
english: Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God Psalm 50:23 continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

paite: Himahleh, thil hihhawih leh thil phal khawng mangngilh kei un; tuabang kithawihna tungah Pathian a lunghi mahmah ngal a.
english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

paite: Nou hawn heutute thu mang unla, a thuthu un awm un, anasepte uh tanchin gen nawn ngei dinga, na khate uh ching a hon veng ahi hi, kipak takin lungkham kawm hilou in, semsak un; huchilouinzaw nou-a ding a khawk ahi zaw ding hi.
english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

paite: Hon thumsak un; bangkima diktat taka awm tuma, sia leh pha theihna siangtak nei ka hi uh chih diktak in ka kithei ngal ua.
english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

paite: Huan, kintak a nakiang ua sawlnawna ka awm theihna ding in, huai tuh hih ding in ka hon ngennawn diak ahi.
english: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

paite: Huan lemna Pathian belam Chingpa thupi tak, I Toupa Jesu mah, khantawna thukhun na sisan vang a misi lak a kipan a pikhenawn pan,
english: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

paite: amitmuha a kipahlam peuhmah, Jesu Kris ziakin eimah a sem in, a deihlam hih ding in thil hoih chiteng lam ah nou hawn hihkim hen: Jesu Kris kiang ah thupina khantawn in awm hen. Amen.
english: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Himahleh, unaute aw, ka hawnngen hi, hasawtna thu ngai thei teitei un; na kiang uah thu tawmchik ka gelh ngal ua,
english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

paite: I unaupa Timothi apawtsak ta uh chih na nathei sam un; ahongpai ma deuh in, amah tawh nou ka hon mu ding hi.
english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

paite: Nou hawn heute tengteng leh, misiangthoute tengteng chibai hon buksak un. Italy gam a mi ten chibai a hon buk uhi.Navek ua kiangah hehpihna awm hen. Amen.
english: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

paite: Navek ua kiangah hehpihna awm hen. Amen.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.
